description: This file defines server request handlers for synchronizing notes and categories with a GitHub repository, including functions to save and retrieve JSON data.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Handles synchronization of notes and categories by creating blobs, trees, commits, and updating Git references in a GitHub repo.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes JSON content from GitHub, decodes from base64, and returns it.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches categories JSON content from GitHub, decodes from base64, and returns it.
